info.name: Maidfort App API
info.description:
All API endpoints from application/modules/app controllers (App.php, User.php, Contest.php, Findtalents.php, Project.php, Projectdetails.php, Workroom.php).

Base URL variable: {{base_url}} e.g. http://yourdomain.com

Auth:
- Customer endpoints: pass ?member_id={{member_id}} in query
- Worker endpoints:   pass ?worker_id={{worker_id}} in query
- Both can coexist on some endpoints
